label: rejected

evidence.V1: Silhouette is a low lumpy mound with three nub bumps; from front/three-quarter it reads as a jelly or rock blob more than a bush, only the top view hints at clustered puffs
evidence.V2: Big mass + gold berries exist, but the medium level (distinct leaf clumps/puffs) is weak: lobes merge into one smooth shell with no internal clump breaks
evidence.V3: Squat 3.7x3.3 dome is a reasonable stylised scale, but the form is a single inflated blob; berries are uniform evenly spaced spheres that look pinned on
evidence.V4: Organic fused shell is soft/blobby overall with no crisp clump edges to catch light; the base edge is a thin dark rim rather than a defined form break
evidence.V5: Light/dark green vertex colour boundary is a jagged sawtooth stepping along triangle edges (visible in three-quarter and close_puffs_flat); close_base_studio shows visible polygon faceting across the lower lobes
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one green hue in two values plus gold berry accent; colourways (autumn, frost) keep the same structure
evidence.V7: 1660 tris vs medium target 2000 (ceiling 4000): at or under target
evidence.V8: Correct single LF_VertexColor material and kit gold accent, but the sawtooth colour split and faceted lobes do not match the smooth weighted-normal kit finish
evidence.V9: Studio line correct for foliage: anchored, CanCollide/CanTouch/CanQuery off, Box fidelity, Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre

artifacts: Sawtooth/stair-stepped vertex colour boundary between top light green and lower dark green
Visible polygon faceting on lower lobes in close_base_studio
140 cross-shell overlaps (berries pushed into shell, intended)
